questions.q: Linda has 28 candies. Chloe has 36 candies. How many do they have in all?
There are 27 red books and 23 blue books. How many books in all?
Mark has 11 stamps. His brother gives him 13 more. How many stamps does he have now?
A teacher has 34 pens. She gives students 7 pens. How many pens does she have left?
Sophia makes 67 paper flowers and gives her friend 17. How many does she have left?
David has 34 marbles. Max has 72. How many more marbles does Max have than David?
Alicia is 7 years old. Her brother is 8 years older. How old is her brother?
Mr Tom has 52 balloons. 25 are red and the rest are green. How many green balloons?
Roden bought 15 goldfish and 7 blue fish. How many fish did he buy?
Thirty dogs are barking. Ten more join. How many dogs are barking?
There are 19 girls and some boys. There are 38 students altogether. How many boys?
There are 100 people. 6 are teachers. 48 are girl students. How many boy students?
Class 2C has 20 girl students. Boys are 6 fewer than girls. How many boys are there?
There are 25 apples, 18 oranges, 12 kiwis, 17 tomatoes. How many more apples than tomatoes?
Mickey has 43 candies. Her father gives 27 more. She eats 25. How many does she have?
Amber has 35 pencils. She gives 19 to a friend, then buys 14 more. How many does she have now?
There are 25 eggs. Mary uses 8 for cakes and her mother buys 12 more. How many eggs now?
Lian has 37 cookies. He gives Jane 13 and Henry 16. How many cookies does he have left?
A class has 28 girl students. The number of boys is 9 fewer. How many boys?
Linda has 34 candies. Chloe has 38. They share all their candies equally with 8 friends. How many does each friend get?
Tom has some marbles. He gives away 15 and has 27 left. How many did he start with?
A shop has 100 items. In the morning they sell 37 items and buy 15 new items. In the afternoon they sell 24 more. How many items are left?
Lan has 3 times as many stickers as Nam. Together they have 48 stickers. How many does Lan have?
A farmer has chickens and rabbits. There are 10 animals in total and 32 legs altogether. How many rabbits are there?
Tom reads 8 pages every day. After 5 days he has 20 pages left. How many pages does the book have?
There are 28 birds on a tree. 9 birds fly away. How many birds are left?
questions.hint: 'Fly away' là bay đi mất — dùng phép trừ.

questions.q: Class 2A has 18 boys and 17 girls. How many students are there in all?
questions.hint: 'In all' là tất cả — cộng số bạn nam và nữ.

questions.q: Hoa is 8 years old. Her brother is 5 years older. How old is her brother?
questions.hint: 'Older' là lớn hơn — cộng thêm số tuổi.

questions.q: A shop has 250 eggs. It sells 130 eggs. How many eggs are left?
questions.hint: 'Sells' là bán đi — dùng phép trừ.

questions.q: Each table has 4 legs. How many legs do 5 tables have?
questions.hint: Nhân số chân một bàn với số bàn.

questions.q: Nam reads 12 pages on Monday and 15 pages on Tuesday. How many pages does he read in two days?
questions.hint: Cộng số trang của hai ngày.

questions.q: There are 30 apples shared equally into 5 baskets. How many apples are in each basket?
questions.hint: 'Shared equally' là chia đều — dùng phép chia.

questions.q: A bus has 45 seats. 38 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
questions.hint: 'Empty' là còn trống — lấy tổng ghế trừ ghế đã ngồi.

questions.q: Mai has 16 stickers. Lan has double that number. How many stickers does Lan have?
questions.hint: 'Double' nghĩa là gấp đôi — nhân với 2.

questions.q: A rope is cut into 3 equal pieces. Each piece is 5 m long. How long was the rope?
questions.hint: Độ dài cả sợi dây = độ dài một đoạn nhân số đoạn.

questions.q: There are 24 students. They stand in rows of 4. How many rows are there?
questions.hint: Chia tổng số bạn cho số bạn mỗi hàng.

questions.q: Minh has 50 marbles. He gives 12 to his friend and then wins 5 more. How many marbles does he have now?
questions.hint: Hai bước: bớt 12 trước, rồi thêm 5.

questions.q: Tom has 36 marbles. He gives 9 marbles to his friend. How many marbles does Tom have left?
questions.hint: 'Gives' là cho đi, 'left' là còn lại — dùng phép trừ.

questions.q: There are 45 students in the schoolyard. 18 more students come. How many students are there now?
questions.hint: 'More ... come' nghĩa là thêm vào — dùng phép cộng.

questions.q: A box has 5 rows of cakes. Each row has 4 cakes. How many cakes are there in all?
questions.hint: 'Each row' gợi ý phép nhân: 5 × 4.

questions.q: Mary has 64 stickers. Anna has 28 stickers. How many more stickers does Mary have than Anna?
questions.hint: 'How many more ... than' là so sánh hơn kém — dùng phép trừ.

questions.q: A farmer has 27 chickens and 35 ducks. How many birds does the farmer have in all?
questions.hint: 'In all' là tất cả — dùng phép cộng.

questions.q: Lan reads 12 pages on Monday and 15 pages on Tuesday. The book has 40 pages. How many pages are left?
questions.hint: Tính số trang đã đọc trước (12+15), rồi lấy 40 trừ đi.

questions.q: A bus has 42 seats. 26 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
questions.hint: 'Empty' là trống — lấy tổng số ghế trừ số ghế đã ngồi.

questions.q: Each week Nam saves 5 thousand dong. How much does he save in 4 weeks?
questions.hint: Mỗi tuần 5 nghìn, 4 tuần thì nhân lên.

questions.q: There are 19 red flowers and some yellow flowers. There are 35 flowers in all. How many yellow flowers are there?
questions.hint: Lấy tổng số hoa trừ đi số hoa đỏ.

questions.q: A baker makes 50 cakes. He sells 23 cakes in the morning and 19 cakes in the afternoon. How many cakes are left?
questions.hint: Tính tổng số bánh đã bán trước, rồi lấy 50 trừ đi.

questions.q: Peter is 8 years old. His brother is 3 years older. How old is his brother?
questions.hint: 'Older' là nhiều tuổi hơn — dùng phép cộng.

questions.q: There are 4 boxes. Each box has 5 pencils. Mai takes 6 pencils. How many pencils are left?
questions.hint: Tính tổng số bút trước (4×5), rồi trừ đi số bút Mai lấy.
